name: CleanClip
tagline: Find previous clipboard items with keyboard shortcuts and queue clips for sequential pasting.
description:
CleanClip keeps a searchable history of copied material on your Mac. Its compact picker opens near your current work, so you can recover a link, image, or text snippet without switching to a separate window.

## Features
- Browse and paste recent items from the keyboard.
- Filter history and collect frequently used clips in smart lists.
- Use the Paste Stack to place several copied items in a chosen order.

## Privacy and requirements
Clipboard history can contain private information. The developer documents local clipboard storage and offers sync on eligible plans. Review the sync and history settings before saving sensitive material.

## Pricing
A free tier is available. Standard, Pro, and Family are one-time purchases for different device limits, starting at $19.99.
